answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake and maintain a verifiable pulse of completed work: each trade is signed, timestamped, and attested by counterparties, building reputation only slowly over time. Reaching the summit of trusted status takes many successful deals, not just a new identity. A yarrow-like flood of fake accounts therefore gains nothing quickly, because each Sybil must separately fund a stake, wait through the same history, and risk forfeiture if it cheats, making large-scale fakery expensive and slow.
